entity_relationship_policy: Module-qualified non-enum domain classes. Direct and generic entity-typed fields are represented as associations; scalar IDs are not inferred as foreign keys. Enums remain scalar attributes. Duplicate document DTOs across modules remain separate Java input units.
usecase_policy: One Spring @Service class is one use-case proxy; all its public non-static methods are operations. Existing module boundary is not a clustering constraint. Module roles are actor proxies.
method_graph_policy: Declared receiver types, this.field selectors, interface-to-implementation expansion, method name/arity; Feign app name/HTTP method/path to Controller route; Mongo/domain types, CrudRepository generic types, and monotonic entity reachability. Method calls inside lambdas are included statically; runtime scheduling and chained return type inference are incomplete. No reflection/runtime dispatch/library implementation modeling.
